title: DoorwayDashboardView
description: Doorway operator dashboard payload — storage stewards, federation peers, projection coverage, and public-surface health. Source of truth: doorway-side aggregation of cluster + reciprocity views over the libp2p view-federation protocol (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted as a new entity.

storageStewards.description: Per-storage-steward rows for peers registered with this doorway.

projectionCoverage.description: Projection cache and lag aggregate for this doorway.

publicSurface.description: DNS/TLS/reachability surface for the doorway hostname.
